messages.author: d01a0ab8c9cf65d0
messages.subject: Permanent usage
parts:
Hello, 
I have a couple of apps in shinyapps.io and I have noticed that there is a repetitive and constant pattern of usage on two of my apps. 



As you can see in this screen capture, it seem that every week day the apps are used during the max sleep time (15 mins x 2 = 0.5 hs), once, twice or even three times a day. My suspicion is that somebody has them open in a browser that refresh them every time the computer awakes, and then the server close the connection. I will of course reduce the idle time limit, but I wonder if there is any way I can track the user, or precent this kind of uses having a Free account. 

Thanks

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Permanent usage
parts:
We don't have built in analytics within of shinyapps.io. However, we do support setting up Google Analytics to track usage of your application. That probably wont help tracking down this specific user, but it can be insightful.

-Andy
